generation.scope: The two Veronese images in each parity intersect scheme-theoretically in the twenty marked evaluations. A single determinant pencil determines four generic indexed windows with Klein Galois group, and the unordered Gale-dual pencil pair determines eight, with dihedral Galois group. The orientation double cover ramifies with index two along the odd-symmetric divisor, where only one finite-edge AS orientation remains.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed scheme-theoretic generation of the intersection, intrinsic recovery of the pencil pair, rotation invariance, finite Galois quotients, and the reflection valuation at the odd-symmetric divisor.

mathematical_computation.scope: Rank 15 of restricted two-by-two minors on both full-rank Veronese varieties; symmetric specialization has ranks 0 and 15. Rotated full-rank sample has nonzero cross and Schur minors and normalized thin ratio -1/8.

open_mathematics: Prove lifting of four central parameters on the entire fifteen-dimensional component via exact degree-four derivation ranks. Determine its closed regular fibers, full center and PI degree, and continue with degenerating pencils.
